criteria.evidence: All four detailed-stage sections plus the ICE are present and substantive: Benefit hypothesis has who ('Serves the product owner who has just installed Garura'), belief ('We believe that when the product owner answers one short set of questions...') and proof ('We will know it is true when: one play (`initialize`) asks the questions...'); Boundary has one In, four Out and four Never lines; Guiding rules has five rules; Features lists five features; ICE has Goal, Limit, Fails if, Context and Checked by lines. No placeholder text.

Lines carry their reason: 'Initialize starts where the install stops, so the two never write the same files.'; 'A tracker is an outside system, and a write there is visible to the whole team.'; 'A proposal with no source hides a guess, and the person cannot judge it.'; 'This keeps the question set in step with what memory actually holds'; 'A second set of questions for the tracker or the review would ask the person the same things twice.' The weakest reason is 'Every part of Garura reads memory that way, so initialize does too.' (consistency only, not why the rule exists), but it does give a reason, and the Features lines are a brief linked index by design.

Every section is a list of discrete bullets with In/Out/Never and Goal/Limit/Fails if labels; features state functions ('asks the product owner the short set of questions...', 'finds the tracker the project uses and the types it has, makes each missing type after a typed yes'), never 'as a user I want'. No flowing story-prose.

The parent domain is one directional paragraph ('This domain turns a business intent into work that agents can build...') marked 'To be deepened later'. The capability goes deeper and narrower: named work-item types ('Business Intent, Epic, Story, Bug, Chore, Spike'), named neighbours it hands off to ('the review play, /check-change', '/shape-slice and /shape-plan'), five features and a concrete check ('run `initialize` on a fresh test project... check its memory folder, the profile, a review record and the tracker's type list').

What: 'After the install, one run of `initialize` sets the project up from the product owner's answers: its memory, its review rule groups and its tracker's work-item types.' Why: 'Today an install copies all of Phoenix memory and a review runs every rule, so a project with no database, no front end or no permissions still gets those standards and those findings, and a play can stop the first time the tracker lacks a work-item type it files.' Edges: the Out lines name the install, the review and work-item filing as other owners, and the Never lines name the hard refusals. Terms such as 'Phoenix memory' and 'rule groups' are not defined, but their meaning can be inferred from how they are used.
